reuse.why: The unlink field-clearing already exists in unlinkAccount (app.ts); instead of extracting that local part into a shared helper and calling it, the diff writes the same updateAccount payload again.

duplication.why: The eight-field db.updateAccount reset in assertAccountIsNotLinked is a verbatim copy of the one in unlinkAccount, so the definition of 'unlinked' now lives in two places.

placement.why: Threading the flag through the existing link.assertAccountIsNotLinked check is the natural seam, but making a function named assert* perform a write blurs the check/mutation split the tree keeps.

scope.why: Only the flag plumbing through the six provider link functions, the link check and a focused test.

maintainability.why: Works within the existing structure but the hidden side effect in an assert function and the copied unlink reset will drift if unlink ever clears another field.

bypasses_abstraction.where: link.ts assertAccountIsNotLinked re-implements the local part of unlinkAccount (app.ts) instead of sharing it.

disguised_duplication.where: The copied updateAccount reset is a plain verbatim copy of unlinkAccount's, not reshaped.
